title: Top 10 Games on Steam This Week: Worth the Money? (Nov 2026)
description:
The 10 games with the most players on Steam in the week to 19 November 2026, ranked by peak concurrent players. Each one gets its price, Steam reviews, Metacritic score where it has one, and a verdict on whether it's worth the money. Number 1 had 224,327 people playing at once.

Which of these are you playing right now? Tell us in the comments.
